description.value: Bean Around The World is a long-established BC coffee roaster — over 30 years in business — known for small-batch, hand-roasted single-origin and blended coffees. The brand operates multiple retail café locations alongside an online store and roastery headquarters in North Vancouver. A visiting cyclist would find a specialty-coffee-focused stop with a well-regarded regional brand behind it.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 13m; stands (16 spaces, covered) at 32m; rack at 49m. Total: 16 spaces.
